title: Dermatlas copy number calling pipeline parameters
description: This pipeline uses Nextflow to generate CNA calls for Dermatlas. The JSON Schema was built using the nf-core pipeline schema builder.

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

outdir.description: The output directory where results will be saved.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.

sample_input_options.title: Sample input options
sample_input_options.description: Paths to sample data and metadata files.

bam_files.description: Path to the top-level directory for BAM files. Use ** glob to recursively collect all BAM files.

all_samples.description: Path to a tab-delimited file containing all matched tumour-normal pairs.

metadata_manifest.description: Path to a tab-delimited manifest containing sample phenotype and preparation information.

subcohorts.description: A map defining subcohort analyses to run after ASCAT completes. Set to false to disable.

manifest_column_options.title: Manifest column configuration
manifest_column_options.description: Configure column names from input metadata manifest.

col_sample_id.description: Column name for sample ID in metadata manifest.

col_sex.description: Column name for sex (M or F) in metadata manifest.

col_include.description: Column name for inclusion flag (Y or N) in metadata manifest.

col_TN.description: Column name for tumour/normal phenotype (T or N) in metadata manifest.

reference_files.title: Reference files
reference_files.description: Paths to reference files required for analysis.

reference_genome.description: Path to the reference genome FASTA file.

bait_set.description: Path to a BED file describing the analysed genomic regions.

resource_files.description: Path to a directory containing ASCAT loci and allele files.

gc_file.description: Path to the ASCAT GC correction file.

rt_file.description: Path to the ASCAT replication timing correction file.

gistic_refgene_file.description: Path to the GISTIC2 reference gene file.

difficult_regions_file.description: Path to a BED file containing problematic genomic regions (GIAB) for GISTIC2 masking.

chrom_arms_file.description: Path to a file containing chromosome arm lengths.

ensembl_transcript.description: Path to the Ensembl transcript annotation file (GFF3) for GISTIC2 filtering.

cancer_gene_list.description: Path to a TSV file containing a cancer gene matrix for GISTIC2 filtering.

oncokb_file.description: Path to an OncoKB cancer gene list file for GISTIC2 filtering.

ascat_goodness_of_fit_threshold.description: Goodness-of-fit threshold (percentage) for filtering ASCAT results.

gistic_broad_peak_q_cutoff.description: Q-value cutoff for filtering GISTIC2 broad peak outputs.

gistic_focal_q_value_cutoff.description: Q-value cutoff for filtering GISTIC2 focal peak outputs.

gistic_log2_thresholds.description: Comma-separated log2 ratio thresholds (deletion,amplification) for GISTIC2 filtering.

print_version.description: Print the pipeline version on startup.

dump_parameters.description: Dump pipeline parameters to a file.

max_job_request_options.title: Max job request options
max_job_request_options.description: Set the top limit for requested resources for any single job.

max_cpus.description: Maximum number of CPUs that can be requested for any single job.

max_memory.description: Maximum amount of memory that can be requested for any single job.

max_time.description: Maximum amount of time that can be requested for any single job.
